Based on the powers described, Create new ones, with new flaws and true name. Make every scenery as detail as possible.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

A realm beyond the last horizon

VEILBOUNDTHE HOLLOW REACH

The old roads have vanished beneath a tide of ash. Something still remembers the way. Make your own oath, gather the scattered echoes, and decide what the silence is worth.

A small original dark-fantasy exploration · no path is written for you
WASD move · mouse look · E interact · Shift sprint · Q gift
VEILBOUNDFIELD NOTES · HOLLOW REACH
THE FIRST ECHOFind the three echo fragments
Current region

CINDER CAUSEWAY

A road of black glass leads through the old pilgrim ruins.

ECHOES 0 / 3
WASD move  E interact  SHIFT run
✧
GIFT · Q
Hold a breath of light
Choose what wakes within you

YOUR OWN BEGINNING

No borrowed destiny. Choose an aspect of the Reach; each gift carries a flaw you must learn to live with.

THE LANTERNWARDEN · GIFT: AUREOLE

Unfurl a ring of pale fire that reveals hidden traces and staggers nearby shades. Flaw — Afterglow: your outline lingers in the dark.

THE ECHOWAYFARER · GIFT: REPRISE

Snap back to where you stood a heartbeat ago, leaving a decoy behind. Flaw — Borrowed Breath: each return briefly slows you.

THE THORNHARBINGER · GIFT: GRASP

Cast a spectral tether to pull yourself toward a distant anchor. Flaw — Open Vein: your gift drains your reserve.

VESPER, WHO KEEPS THE UNLIT
Aureole · The Pale Ward
Afterglow
Still becoming
The Reach will answer to the name you make.
Your journey is held

PAUSED

Take a breath, wayfarer. The Reach can wait.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D dark-fantasy exploration game inspired by the requested Shadow Slave setting, with first- and third-person views and a player-chosen path rather than reenacting Sunny’s choices.

## Requirements
- Detailed scenery and places; custom powers, flaws, and true names; free player-directed path.
- User asked to proceed without clarifying questions and note assumptions briefly at completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original setting, “Veilbound: The Hollow Reach,” with distinct regions, original lore, and three player-selected paths.
- Built as a browser game using Three.js from a CDN, without adding a package setup.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the 3D world, exploration controls, HUD, path selection, echo-collection objective, shrine ending, and mobile controls.
- Added first-/third-person toggle, original abilities/flaws/true names, pause control, and ambient audio toggle.
- Fixed a Three.js runtime issue by changing `new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.8,.1)` to detail `0`.

### Active
- Retest the game after the geometry fix; verify the scene renders and gameplay UI/actions work.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not launch because its expected Chromium installation is missing. System Chromium is available and was used for a headless check.

## Next Move
1. Run `chromium --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --enable-logging=stderr --dump-dom http://localhost:3002` and verify the prior Three.js error is gone.
2. If possible, capture and inspect a rendered screenshot, then fix any runtime or visual issues.
3. Finish with a brief summary, noting the interpretation as an original dark-fantasy world rather than an exhaustive recreation of the novel.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, styling, title screen, path choice, and responsive controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, player controls, abilities, exploration, interactions, and game state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A Python HTTP server was started on port `3002`.
- The first headless Chromium check reported `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'x')` in Three.js polyhedron subdivision; the fractional octahedron detail was corrected but not yet retested.
